title: Open direct image and the all-continuous algebraic-closure coefficient-change mate
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ with the topology of the extended $\ell$-adic absolute value, and a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$, $p\ne\ell$. All schemes below are separated of finite type over $k$ [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Put $B(S)=C(S,\Omega)$ on profinite sets, with all continuous maps, and $A_E(S)=C(S,E)$ for a finite intermediate extension $\mathbf Q_\ell\subseteq E\subseteq\Omega$ with its restricted norm topology [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring]. Put $B_T=p_T^*B$ and $A_{E,T}=p_T^*A_E$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. The continuous inclusion $E\hookrightarrow\Omega$ gives the coefficient map $A_{E,T}\to B_T$ by postcomposition and pullback [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring-map]. Modules are internal module objects [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ be a quasi-compact open $k$-immersion [def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-finite-type-morphism] and fix one finite intermediate field $E$. Let $C\in D(\operatorname{Mod}_{A_{E,U}})$ have bounded cohomology with finite constant local models on finite constructible stratifications [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. Write $L_T=B_T\otimes^L_{A_{E,T}}-$ for derived coefficient extension [sk-def-sfb-derived-extension-of-scalars] and $Rj_{*,A_E},Rj_{*,B}$ for the ordinary total right derived module direct images [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. The canonical morphism
$$\beta_C:L_XRj_{*,A_E}C\longrightarrow Rj_{*,B}L_UC$$
is an isomorphism. Precisely, under $j_B^*\dashv Rj_{*,B}$ it is adjoint to
$$j_B^*L_XRj_{*,A_E}C\ \cong\ L_Uj_{A_E}^*Rj_{*,A_E}C\ \xrightarrow{L_U(\epsilon_C)}\ L_UC,$$
where $\epsilon$ is the $A_E$-coefficient counit and the displayed comparison is pullback/tensor compatibility [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. All categories are ordinary ambient module derived categories; no completion of $\Omega$ or coefficient sheaf, and no filtered-union interpretation of $B$, is used. No constructibility conclusion about either side is part of this statement.

proof.text: Use lem-sfb-derived-scalar-mate-thick-locus with $A=A_E$, $B=C(-,\Omega)$ and $f=j$. Its $\beta$ is exactly the counit mate in the statement, and its invertibility locus is thick in the ordinary ambient derived category. By lem-sfb-tame-pair-proper-generators it therefore suffices to take $G=Rq_{*,A_E}K$, $K=(b_!L)[0]$, with $p:Y\to X$ and $q:V\to U$ proper, $V=p^{-1}U$, $j':V\hookrightarrow Y$, and the regular tame-pair data specified by that node. No regularity or tameness is imposed on the original $C$.

source.place: Paragraph (3), retained proper/tame reduction; repaired assembly step 1

proof.text: For such a generator, finite-rank lisse $L$ is pro-etale locally isomorphic to $A_{E,W}^{r}$, so it has the finite constant scalar model $E^{r}$ on the trivial stratification. The schemes of the generator are Noetherian. The exact extension-by-zero assertion of lem-sfb-scalar-model-immersion-extension gives $K\in\Dbc(V,A_E)$. The finite-$E$ case, and only that case, of lem-sfb-rational-open-direct-image-constructible gives $Rj'_{*,A_E}K\in\Dbc(Y,A_E)$. These are precisely the two bounded-constructible hypotheses needed below for the proper comparison input. No corresponding constructibility assertion for the all-continuous coefficient ring is used.

source.place: Paragraph (3), retained proper/tame reduction; repaired assembly step 2

proof.text:
Apply lem-sfb-derived-scalar-mate-composition to $jq=pj'$ and $K$. Its normalized compositors give
$$Rj_{*,B}(\beta_{q,K})\circ\beta_{j,G}=Rp_{*,B}(\beta_{j',K})\circ\beta_{p,Rj'_{*,A_E}K}.$$
The proper comparisons for $q$ on $K$ and for $p$ on $Rj'_{*,A_E}K$ are isomorphisms by lem-sfb-continuous-algcl-proper-scalar-comparison; step 2 checked both input hypotheses. The regularity, strict normal crossings, outer components and tame $L$ of the chosen pair give invertibility of $\beta_{j',K}$ by lem-sfb-continuous-algcl-tame-boundary-comparison. Derived direct image preserves inverses, so both the right side and $Rj_{*,B}(\beta_{q,K})$ are invertible. Cancel the latter to obtain invertibility of $\beta_{j,G}$. The thick-generation reduction in step 1 proves the assertion for $C$, with its prescribed counit normalization.
